name: Visual Privacy Agent
description: On-device screen understanding with local PII redaction before any data leaves the browser. Sanitized context is sent to a server-side VLM/LLM which returns a UI action.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' data: http://localhost:5000 http://127.0.0.1:5000 https://huggingface.co https://cdn-lfs.huggingface.co https://cdn-lfs-us-1.huggingface.co;
